results.controlIntent: a. Develop and document an inventory of system components that: 1. Accurately reflects the system; 2. Includes all components within the system; 3. Does not include duplicate accounting of components or of components assigned to any other system; 4. Uses the granularity deemed necessary for tracking and reporting; and 5. Includes the following information to achieve system component accountability: [Assignment: organization-defined information deemed necessary to achieve effective system component accountability]; and b. At [Assignment: organization-defined frequency], review and update the system component inventory.

judgment.rationale: The evidence retrieved shows that a model registry entry and endpoint configuration exist for "churn-predictor-v1" / "churn-predictor-endpoint," providing a partial system component inventory. Positive indicators include: (1) a versioned model package (version 1) with a unique ARN (`arn:aws:sagemaker:us-east-1:123456789012:model-package/churn-predictor/1`), creation and approval timestamps, and an approval status of "Approved" — satisfying basic accountability metadata requirements; (2) endpoint configuration records the instance type (`ml.m5.large`) and endpoint status (`InService`), contributing to component-level granularity. However, several gaps prevent full satisfaction of CM-8.v2: (a) The model registry entry shows a null/absent lineage field, meaning upstream training data sources, containers, and pipeline steps are not captured in the inventory; (b) Data capture is disabled (`dataCaptureEnabled: false`, `capturePercentage: 0`, `captureDestination: null`), indicating that runtime inference traffic is not being recorded — a component behavior that should be inventoried for accountability; (c) Network isolation is disabled (`enableNetworkIsolation: false`), and there is no evidence this configuration choice is documented in the inventory; (d) No evidence was retrieved regarding the frequency of inventory review and update (CM-8.v2.b), nor any policy or schedule governing such reviews; (e) It cannot be determined from available tools whether duplicate accounting exists or whether all sub-components (e.g., container images, VPC settings, IAM roles) are included.
gaps: Model lineage is absent from the registry entry — training pipeline, data sources, and container images are not inventoried
No evidence of an inventory review schedule or frequency policy (CM-8.v2.b)
Data capture is disabled; runtime inference behavior is not recorded or inventoried
Network isolation is disabled with no documented rationale in the inventory
Cannot confirm absence of duplicate component accounting across systems
Sub-components such as IAM roles, VPC/security group settings, and container image digests are not captured by available collectors
Human attestation needed to confirm whether a broader CMDB or asset management system supplements these AWS-native records
